description: The real backend/packages/trivia/recipe.json (2026-09-05, the fourth real plugin built on host.fetch): a single, zero-input fetch+pick+pick+format chain against opentdb.com, using a response shape captured from a real call - including its HTML-entity-encoded text (Cartoon & Animations, "killed"), proving interpolate()'s entity-decoding fix works in the actual shipped plugin, not just the regression fixture.

results.question: What is the name of the Alligator that The Simpsons "killed" in the episode "Kill The Alligator and Run"?

reply.text: What is the name of the Alligator that The Simpsons "killed" in the episode "Kill The Alligator and Run"? The answer: Captain Jack.
